name: Result
summary: The end of a flow: one statement of what happened, a line of explanation, and the way out. It is the whole answer on one screen, not a toast that disappears.
summaryZh: 一个流程的结尾:一句话说明发生了什么,一行解释,再给出下一步。它是整个答案,占住一屏,而不是一条会消失的提示。

variants.name: Success
variants.note: The plate behind the icon takes the success tint.

variants.name: Warning
variants.note: The plate behind the icon takes the warning tint.

variants.name: Danger
variants.note: The plate behind the icon takes the danger tint.

variants.name: Info
variants.note: The plate behind the icon takes the neutral tint.

parts.name: Icon
parts.note: The slot for the icon. It ships empty and the host puts its own SVG in it.

parts.name: Subtitle
parts.note: The line under the title: the detail, or the reason.

parts.name: Extra
parts.note: The way out. It holds the host's own controls.

props.name: variant
props.description: The tone of the plate behind the icon. Without a variant the plate takes the brand colour.
props.descriptionZh: 图标后面那块底板的色调。不带变体时底板取品牌色。

props.name: title
props.description: What happened. It should be a real heading element, so the page keeps its outline.
props.descriptionZh: 发生了什么。应该用真正的标题元素,页面的大纲才不会乱。

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The icon. The slot is empty and takes an SVG from the host.
slots.descriptionZh: 图标。这个插槽是空的,由使用方放自己的 SVG 进去。

slots.name: sub-title
slots.description: The line under the headline, under the name Element Plus gives it. It fills the same part as the subtitle slot.
slots.descriptionZh: 标题下面那一行,用的是 Element Plus 的叫法。它和副标题插槽填的是同一块。

a11y.notes: The title should be a real heading element — the class sets its size, so the document outline stays right. The icon is decoration: mark the slot aria-hidden, because an icon that repeats the title is read twice. The buttons in the actions area are real buttons, so they are focusable and reachable by keyboard.
a11y.notesZh: 标题要用真正的标题元素 —— 类已经定了字号,文档大纲才不会乱。图标是装饰:给插槽加上 aria-hidden,因为和标题重复的图标会被念两遍。操作区里的按钮是真按钮,可以聚焦,键盘能走到。

examples.title: A result
examples.description: The icon slot is empty: the host is meant to put its own SVG in it, so the library does not ship an icon font or an emoji. What the host puts inside inherits the colour of the plate.
examples.descriptionZh: 图标插槽是空的:本来就该由使用方放自己的 SVG 进去,所以库里不放图标字体,也不放 emoji。使用方放进去的东西会继承这块底板的颜色。
examples.markup:
Deployment finished

Build 214 passed on all three nodes.

examples.title: Tones
examples.description: Four variants tint the plate behind the icon. The tint is the soft one, and the icon takes the foreground derived for that tint, so it stays readable in every mood.
examples.descriptionZh: 四个变体给图标后面的底板上淡色。这个淡色是柔色版,图标取的是为这块淡色派生的前景色,所以在每套 mood 里都读得清。

The card was declined by the issuer.

Nothing scheduled

There is no run in the next seven days.

notes: The library draws the plate the icon sits on and the size of the box, and stops there. The icon itself is the host's: an icon font would pull a font file into every consumer, and an emoji looks different on every operating system, so the slot ships empty and the host fills it with its own SVG.
notesZh: 库只画图标待的那块底板和盒子的大小,到这儿就停。图标本身是用得着的:图标字体会让每个使用方都多拉一个字体文件,emoji 在不同系统上长得又不一样,所以插槽是空的,由使用方放自己的 SVG 进去。
